title: AWS: Canadian local time rules for Db2 instances (behavior change)
summary: As of November 1, 2026, these provinces and territories observe permanent daylight saving time and no longer set their clocks back by an hour
replacement: Select the new America/Vancouver, America/Edmonton, America/Inuvik, or America/Winnipeg time zone when creating a new RDS for Db2 instance; to change an existing instance's time zone, contact AWS Support.
